issues.title: rotor_od hardcoded to 135.6; from-zero modeling fails for stator_id < 135.6
issues.repro: venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/main.py --params "slots=12 poles=8 stator_od=150 stator_id=93 slot_type=pear" --output_dir D:/ANSYS_Run/audit_20261107/gen
issues.stderr_summary: (empty stderr) stdout: '转子: 135.6mm / 48.0mm' then 'ERROR: 转子外径必须小于定子内径'
issues.root_cause: Dataclass default rotor_od=135.6/airgap=0.2 are 36slot preset constants; no geometric derivation from stator_id/airgap in __post_init__ or from_dict.
issues.fix: Derive rotor_od = stator_id - 2*airgap when not explicitly supplied; airgap = clamp(0.3 + stator_od/400, 0.35, 2.0); add tests for Dsi<135.6, Dsi>135.6, explicit rotor_od.

issues.title: Report pipeline dependencies undeclared (matplotlib/numpy/pytest), clean env fails at import
issues.stderr_summary: make_report.py:411 SyntaxWarning invalid escape '\P'; line 17 import matplotlib -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'matplotlib'
issues.root_cause: matplotlib/numpy only in [plot] extra, pytest only in [dev]; neither SKILL.md nor project README states the prerequisite.
issues.fix: Either move numpy>=1.26/matplotlib>=3.7 into dependencies, or document 'pip install -e ".[plot,dev]"' as a hard prerequisite and raise a readable Chinese ImportError hint.

issues.title: stack_length never consumed; Maxwell 2D ModelDepth unset (160x torque/loss error)
issues.repro: venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/main.py --params "... stack_length=160" --output_dir gen && grep -c ModelDepth gen/setup.py
issues.root_cause: config.stack_length is only assigned in interactive mode and is never emitted as 2D ModelDepth; repo-wide grep finds ModelDepth only in debug/ readers (aedt_parser, com_extractor, run_debug). Archived project output_scripts/36slot_industrial_motor.aedt:248 shows ModelDepth='1meter' default leakage.
issues.fix: Emit ModelDepth in SetDesignSettings for both main.py-generated setup.py and solve_25Nm_SPMSM.py; add regression check grep -c ModelDepth >= 1 and assert stack_length > 0 in validate().

issues.title: Unknown params silently dropped; power/speed input yields default machine with rc=0
issues.line_hint: MotorConfig.from_dict: filtered_data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in valid_fields}
issues.stderr_summary: none - prints '[DONE] 脚本生成成功'
issues.root_cause: from_dict filters unknown keys without warning; auto-derivation lives in scripts/motor_param_calc.py which main.py never calls, contradicting SKILL.md section 1.
issues.fix: Raise ValueError listing valid keys for unknown fields; or route power/speed through motor_param_calc before building; align SKILL.md wording with the actual entry point.

issues.title: WINDING_KW=0.933 contradicts truth table 0.866 for 8p12s; tooth flux density underestimated 7.7%
issues.stderr_summary: n/a - value mismatch; 0.933 is the 10p/12s winding factor
issues.root_cause: Copy-paste from the 10p/12s case; propagates into sim_analytical (phi = E/(4.44 f N kw)) and all S4 baselines / reports.
issues.fix: Set 0.866, rerun S4, update DESIGN_PROGRESS baseline; add validate() assertion abs(kw - canonical_kw(12,8)) < 1e-3. Effect: Bg 0.776->0.836 T (still in band), B_tooth 1.651->1.779 T (8% above Bsat 1.65 T).

issues.title: Rated torque self-check is circular: T_avg echoed from input
issues.stderr_summary: n/a - sim_summary.json shows T_avg=25.0 (input) vs T_calc=22.53 (-9.9%)
issues.root_cause: res['rated_load']['T_avg'] = T_rated instead of the computed torque.
issues.fix: Use T_calc (or 0.95*T_calc with end/harmonic allowance) as T_avg, keep T_rated as target, and close the 10% gap by design action (turns 81->88 or stack 160->176) instead of echoing.
